description.value: Ladner Sushi has been a fixture in Ladner Village since 2014, handcrafting sushi, sashimi, nigiri, and Japanese comfort food including bento boxes, donburi, and teriyaki across an extensive menu. The restaurant participates in Ladner's famous summer Farmer's Markets and supports local school food programs, making it a community-oriented stop. Online and mobile ordering with in-town delivery is available across all platforms.
